name: assistsec-landing
description: AssistSec marketing site (frontend/) and its blog CMS backend (backend/).

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
